batting.dismissal: st AC Gilchrist b PP Ojha

batting.dismissal: c MC Henriques b AB Dinda

balls.text: cleans him up with a yorker on leg and middle, he makes room but fails to dig it out and the stumps take a beating, RP finishes with a four-for
swats it wide of Rohit at cover who fumbles to allow them to come back for the second
pushed through quick at 126 kmph on the off, Ishant made way to pull it wide of midwicket, missed it, came onto him a little too quickly, and the off stump was pegged back
full on the off, crunched down towards long-off
struck well, on middle, makes way for himself and forces it through to deep cover
mixing it up nicely, bowled a slower one seeing Kartik give himself some room, dragged it short and it cut away to beat the bat
attempted yorker on leg stump, rapped on the pads but that was going down, gets a leg bye to fine leg
bowled short, at 135.4 kmph, on middle, defended back to the bowler
low full toss outside off, fails to connect well as he tries to drive that past cover, drops wide of the bowler and they steal a single
short outside off, makes room and carts it over cover for a couple
gets forward and chips it into the gap between long-off and deep cover, a wild throw comes in from the deep that's well backed up, they take a couple
overpitched on the off stump, gets forward and drives it through the line to long-off
high full toss on middle, pushed back past the bowler for a single to long-off
Ishant gets into the act, slower ball, a legcutter gone bad, ends up short and he makes room to swat it well over deep cover
aiming for a yorker, ends up being a full toss, played back to the bowler
low full toss outside off, makes room and slices it down to third man
attempted yorker handled well by Ishant, waited for it and got his bat down to dig it out into the off side
bowled short on middle, defended to cover off the back foot
pushed wide of midwicket for a single and give Ishant Sharma the strike

run out, superb stuff from Rohit, driven wide of him at cover, he dives full length to his left, takes aim and throws down the stumps at the non-striker's end to find Agarkar miles short of his ground
shot! He made room and the bowler chased him but it was wide enough to get a free swing of the arms, and it sailed over the long-on boundary
short in leg stump, whipped away wide of short fine but a dive to his left keeps them down to just a run
gets off the mark, taps it in front of midwicket to face the music the next over

one more, and its Rohit who snaps a sharp one this time, betters Gibbs, full and wide and he's into the drive, strikes it firmly but Rohit Sharma at cover is quick to bend low and snap it inches from the ground, Kolkata sink further
full on the off, drives it uppishly to long-off for a single

Not the best of deliveries but it earns him a wicket thanks to some sharp fielding by Gibbs, it's short and wide and is cut powerfully but Gibbs is in perfect position at point, just bends a little low and takes it in front of his face, the crowd roars
pressure on Styris now, full on middle, he comes down the track and drills it down the ground to split the gab between long-off and long-on
Styris is one bowler who has struggled a bit today, bowling too short, Hodge shuffles and helps it on its way wide of short fine for a boundary
saw him come down and dragged it short, Hodge slaps it down to deep midwicket to keep the strike
slower ball bowled on a good length on the off stump, at 99.8 kmph, tapped down to point
he's already moved across, he bowled a full toss on middle, struck firmly down to deep midwicket
length on the off stump, tries to push it through wide of the bowler, hits the inside half of the bat and rolls down to long-on
full and wide, square-drives it towards deep point for a single
slower ball banged in short on the off, moves across, rolls his wrists over it and plays it down wide of square leg for a quick single
on middle and leg, tucked away in front of square towards midwicket, will they get to a 100?
played away from his body there, got the outside edge but well wide of the keeper to third man
chopped it down to Gibbs at point and the crowd roared, imagine what it'll be like when he's out to bat

bowled full this time, tried to surprise him with the yorker, Hodge struggled to dig it out, almost got bowled but was fortunate to get an inside edge falling forward to get it to the fine-leg boundary
takes his bottom hand off and drops it down to third man for a single
dragged it short on middle, struck down to deep midwicket for a single
dipping into the right hander and spins away after landing on middle, gets a leading edge as he tries to tap that into the leg side
flighted on middle, pushed away towards deep midwicket
flat and quick outside off, went for the drive, got a thick edge behind point for three runs, not convincing, but he'll be happy to get off the mark
flat on middle and off, defended into the leg side
tempted him with a flighted one on the off stump, he danced down the track and had a massive swipe, it spun away to beat the bat and Gilchrist did the rest, spinners continue to thrive in the IPL
on middle and off, moved across and turned it behind square for a single
shot! Pitched it short once too often, made room and cut it away fiercely over the deep-point region for a big six
struck down to Laxman at short midwicket where he prevents a couple of runs diving to his left
maintaining a shortish length here, Shukla shapes up for a pull but makes no contact
pitched it short on the off stump, made room to cut it away wide of third man for a single
charges down the track and pulls it over midwicket, connected it well and got a much needed, pressure-relieving four
short outside off, chopped down to point
short on middle and leg, tried to pull it square, hit on the thighs
goes after him immediately, worth it as there was no long-off, had a massive swing, mistimed it but it cleared mid-off comfortably

done in by the spin! Gave him the charge even before it was bowled, saw him come down and dragged it slightly short on the off and got it to spin away as he pushed at it, Gilchrist took it cleanly and clipped the bails to find him well short
pushed into the off side off the front foot for a single
reverse-pull that almost lands him in trouble, short on leg stump and he plays it uppishly wide of a diving point, shows how difficult it is even to get singles
on middle and off, moves across to push it wide of midwicket

tried to improvise, bowled short on the off and he shuffled to paddle it over the keeper, Edwards did splendidly diving full length to his left to drag that back in just inside the ropes, or so it seemed. Replays show the body was in contact with the ropes as the ball flicked his trousers. First boundary in some time, but Deccan have taken the honours in the first half of the innings
tries to play across the line and is almost done in, pushed through full, he moved across to drive it past midwicket, missed
excellent stuff, short again, chopped down to cover, it's crowded infield on the off side
short on the off stump, fended away to square leg, where the fielder runs in to prevent a single
driving length on the off stump again, pushed back firmly but straight to the bowler
starts off bowling on a length on the off, mistimes a drive towards point
dipping into the right hander from round the wicket, tries to work it away but is hit on the pads, would have gone down
tossed up on leg stump and spins away to take the batsman by surprise, he looks to play it down the leg side but gets the leading edge as the ball zips away
flighted on the off stump, drawing him out of the crease, he comes down and bunts it down to long-off
gets back and punches it towards deep cover, slightly short
flat again, and much quicker through the air, pushed through the line to cover
on middle and off, bowled flat, defended back onto the pitch
nips it back in this time, Hodge drops it short of square leg for a quick single
back of a length on middle, punched to midwicket, dot ball again, this is some bowling, keeping it neat, sticking to the basics and they've done a fantastic job
short outside off and getting it to move away from Hodge as he went for the cut
appeals but he was outside the line, angling it into the right hander, Chopra walks across to play it wide of midwicket, is struck on the pads, was also way outside his crease
full on the off stump, gentle medium this but accurate, 119 kmph, pushed straight to cover
slower ball bowled short outside off, Chopra tries to dab it down to third man but is into the shot too early, misses
good going, pitches it slightly short but it's much quicker, cut down to point
flatter trajectory this time, probing hi outside off stump, he pokes it to point
on middle, gets across the line and dabs it down to midwicket
flighted on middle, driven to cover off the front foot
gave it some air, landed on leg stump and spun away sharply, Chopra did well to keep it down on the off side
on middle and off, nurdled into the leg side wide of square leg
unlucky, brought it back in this time, Chopra got back to defend but got the outside edge wide of gully to beat third man
nicely done, bowled it a touch full on the off, invited the batsman out of his crease and play the drive, Chopra did well though, didn't go hard at it, just pushed it gently to cover
sliding down leg this time, given a wide
on the off stump from wide of the crease, pushed in front of cover for a single
bowled short on leg stump, tried to tickle it fine, went off the thigh pad towards Gilchrist who failed to collect

Harmeet strikes and Kolkata are in some trouble now! Full and wide, Ganguly's tempted, he makes room but way too much  and reaches for it to play it in the direction of cover, gets a thick edge and it flies off straight to slip where Laxman snaps a sharp one
gentle medium at 114.6 kmph, bowled short on the off stump, pulled away to fine leg
good length outside off, he stays rooted to his crease and tries to run it down to third man, fails to reach it, Deccan have put the lid on the scoring here
slower one, bowled at 121.3 kmph, Ganguly didn't pick it, was too early into his attempted pull, got an under-edge on the bounce to the keeper
bouncer on middle but Hodge negotiates it well, getting back and hooking it, though not well enough, for a single behind square leg
much straighter, bowled from wide of the crease into middle, pushed solidly back to the bowler
short of a good length on the off, defended to cover as Gibbs fields and gets a cheer
tries to get it into the blockhole, almost succeeds, straying in line though, outside leg stump, clips the pads for leg byes towards fine leg
slightly shorter, but in the channel outside off again, left alone to the keeper
beaten, probing line outside off and moved away as Ganguly hung his bat out without any conviction

gone, big wicket! Excellent comeback, realised his mistake, pushed it much fuller, landed on a length on middle and Gayle tried to clip that away over midwicket, there was some late movement that took the leading edge, Harmeet Singh ran in from long-off to pouch a well-judged catch
he's into his groove now, short again and he's onto it immediately, shaped himself up for a pull and smashed it out of the ground, that's massive
short and wide and Gayle cashes in, picks the length early to get back and cut it fiercely behind point
bouncer on the off, Gayle backs away from the pull upon realising it's a little too high
brought it back in and deceived him completely, bowled full this time and Ganguly could not bring his bat down in time, was lucky that wasn't bowled on the stumps
similar length but doesn't bounce as much, gets back and cuts it down firmly but straight to a diving gully
almost, short outside off, dabs at it away from his body and almost spoons it to a squarish gully who's waiting exactly for that shot
bouncer on the off, working up some good pace here, Ganguly has nothing to do with it
short outside off but gets excellent bounce, Ganguly looks to cut that with a slight leap but misses, Gilchrist takes it head high
banged in short on middle, fired in at 141.5 kmph, does well to keep it down on the off side, albeit a little awkwardly
held it back again, on middle and off, defended to point, Deccan have done well here, nice start by both their seamers

an act of desperation there, just a fraction short on the off and moved back in, Gayle attempted one of his typical Caribbean pulls wide of midwicket, missed as he was probably surprised by the bounce
taps it into the off side and calls for a single but is sent back wisely, cover is quick on his feet to keep them to the crease
bringing it back into Gayle, it's short and wide enough for him to shoulder arms to that one
short of a good length outside off, run down to third man for a single, he's off
he's give him! McCullum's shaking his head, but he's disappointed with himself, short outside leg, tries to work it fine, ends up getting a tickle on the gloves through to the keeper
into the blockhole on the off stump, bang on target, what a nice graceful rhythmic action he has, Gayle plays it well, digging it out on the leg side, end of an excellent over
banged it in short again, clocking 139.5 kmph</i<, leaving Gayle and he lets it through
short of a length outside off and shaping away from the left hander, left alone again, into the rythm nicely
full and wide, respectfully lets it go, just warming up
straying on the pads, bowled at a good paceof 141.3 kmph, fends it away into the leg side, Kolkata off the mark
nice slingy action, testing line just slightly outside off, McCullum drops it down to cover
takes him just one ball as Gibbs dances down to cream that over cover for a boundary, that was all power and got to the ropes in a flash
spun away to beat the outside off, he got forward to defend but wasn;t to the pitch and didn't read the spin
shorter on leg stump, went straight through to strike him on the pads as he tried to turn it away, but was going down
tossed up down leg, swept down to fine leg for a single, just two more needed now
worked away through square leg for a single
beautifully struck, not much effort there, just pure timing, flighted and he cashes in, getting to the pitch to clear long-off comfortably
spat off the pitch and turned to deceive Gibbs, slightly short on middle but zipped away as he got forward to defend, even McCullum was taken bu surprise
tossed up outside off, not much spin on that one, left alone
three more, swept down fine, fetched it from outside off, McCullum moved well to his left but it beat him, was timed well but fine leg got across to cut it off
the end is near now, tossed up on middle, plants his foot forward and slog-sweeps that well over deep midwicket
gets froward and pushes it to midwicket, much straighter
fired in full outside leg stump, poor ball really, Gibbs paddles that smartly into the vacant fine-leg region for a boundary
on middle and leg, moves across and pushes it wide of square leg
punched off the back foot towards a deepish mid-on for a quick single
short on middle, dropped into the leg side using his wrists
easily done, quicker through the air, bowled full on middle, hit it cleanly through the line over the bowler's head for a boundary
short on the off stump, chopped down to point
they're doing this easily, pushed between point and cover
flighted outside leg, swept down wide of short fine for a couple
Agarkar has been punished, just in his first over, I don't think we'll see more of him this match, dropped it short again and Rohit pulled it all along the ground wide of midwicket
short of a good length, taps it to cover off the back foot
short again on middle, swatted away to deep midwicket, well hit, but straight to the fielder, Agarkar can breathe easy
short and wide, they've picked him, Gibbs charges forward and chases it, the away movement takes it past him but it's called a wide
punches at it hard off the back foot, gets a thick outside edge to third man

edged and just wide of the diving keeper, held it back this time, bowled it short this time, just marginally outside off, opened the face at just the right time to get it past McCullum, deliberately done
he's welcomed with a mighty six over long-off, gentle loosener bowled on a length on the off and Rohit smashes it back over the bowler's head, sailed into the stands
down the track again and clips it over midwicket for a single
down the track, is not quite to the pitch but goes through with the attempted loft, gets it into the gap between long-on and deep midwicket but he hasn't timed it well enough, gets a couple
pushed through gently between point and cover for a single
turned away into the leg side wide of midwicket
tossed up again but pitched it on a good length this time, drew him forward and he was into the drive, spun away to take the outside edge but fell well short of a slightly deepish first slip
tossed up on leg stump, closes the face to play that into the vacant region on the leg side and gets a single
just a fraction short and Rohit, we'll call him that from here on, is tempted to go for the cut, the ball spits away to just beat the outside edge
on and outside off, gets forward, waits for it and guides that wide of point
on middle and leg, flicked uppishly again but well into the gap, wide of square leg for a single
short on the off, hangs his bat out to dab that behind point for a single
a pressure-relieving boundary that, bowled full on the off stump, went front and across, bent low and swiped it past short fine
straying on the pads, clips it uppishly just wide of a diving midwicket, risky there, couldn't keep it down
tossed up outside leg stump, swept to short fine, good over first up, the scoring has subsided here, though Gibbs is still there
driven down the ground to mid-on off the front foot
short on the off, punched to cover off the back foot, bowled Karts yells out McCullum
tossed up on the off, drives forward but cover cuts it off well moving to is right
on middle and off, defended watchfully into the off side
holds back the length a touch and Sharma rides the bounce well to gently drop the ball behind backward point for a single to end the over
well bowled again, moving it a fraction closer to off stump to force Sharma onto the front foot, the ball sits up and hits his glove as he pushes at it
a confident leave that, shouldering arms to one thats pitched up wide of off stump and gently slanting back in with the natural Ishant angle
just back of a length outside off stump and defended to cover
short of a length on the stumps and he under-edges a pull to square
pitches it up and Gibbs, with minimal footwork, drives to cover
eases onto the front foot and drives the ball to cover

a bit of indecision and an alert piece of fielding gets Laxman! A good-length delivery nips in a touch from just outside off stump, Laxman makes room and is just about in time to bring the bat down on ball, squirting it towards backward point, he sets off after hesitation and is sent back but is a frame late to get his bat across as a good throw from Shukla comes into McCullum
now, now, whats he doing? After the caress comes an ugly swipe across the line, wanted to pull it through square but failed to connect on the slower off cutter
thats a punchy shot off the middle, a real Laxman classic, just picked the length and poked it off the back foot into the gap between cover and point, really good to see
pitched up on off stump and Laxman on-drives to the fielder
pitches on middle and off and Gibbs clips it wide of mid-on
angling it into him, clips it away to midwicket, not much feet movement there but that's how he plays
short on middle and off, pushed off the back foot wide of cover, decides against the single
beaten by the movement this time, tried to guide it to third man but the ball zipped away to just beat the outside edge
Laxman hits a six! That was bludgeoned, banged in short on middle, picked the length quickly, was on the front foot as he pulled it away with utter contempt for a flat six over square leg
shortish on middle, pushed back to the bowler off the back foot, presented the full face there
back of a length on the off, played away from his body a little, dabbing it to point
probing length on the off stump, defended solidly towards cover

the drop catch doesn't prove too costly, goes for a mighty pull over midwicket, doesn't pick the length right, it's just a fraction short, mistimes it and it takes forever to come down but Henriques at square leg judges it to perfection taking a couple of steps back and taking it on his chest
length ball and Glichrist is under it nicely, strikes it well over mid-off, though it's not his best-timed stroke, and it has enough on it to roll over the ropes
full on middle and leg, pushed through to a deepish mid-on for a single
lucky and gets four, charges down the track and swipe Dinda through midwicket, gets a thin inside edge to evade leg stump and the keeper to the fine-leg boundary
dropped, Gilchrist comes forward and crunches it wide of Hodge who times his dive to the right well but fails to hold on, should have done so, you can't let it slip against Glichrist
teasing line outside off but Gibbs restrains himself, shouldering arms to let it through to the keeper
short on middle, gets across and drops it behind square for a single
good length in the channel outside off, bowled at 137.2 kmph, left alone to the keeper
he's fine now, cracks it off the back foot over midwicket, banged in short and he dispatched it with no trouble whatsoever
short on the off, guided towards a diving Kartik at gully
back of a length on the off, dabs it down to point
got his front foot across to a ball fired in on middle and clipped it uppishly wide of square leg for a couple more
Gibbs is away, short on middle and he pulls it away in style over square leg, a roll of the wrists it's off, big cheer from the home crowd
angling into the batsman from wide of the crease, pushed through on a length on middle, played towards mid-on
just a fraction short outside off, latches onto it in a flash, cutting it away between point and cover for three runs to get his team underway
a bit of the chip there, landed short of cover but was not totally committed to the drive on the up
punches a short ball firmly off the back foot to cover, went off the middle
